answer: Every identity locks a 50 POA bond in the vault, decaying 2 POA per epoch unless real work refreshes it. Newcomers dock in the harbor for three probation epochs at half rewards. Any bond falling below the umber line is struck from the registry and must bond anew. A rented-bond ring still bleeds per identity, so forging 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 POA and burns 40,000 over 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays 50 once, works, and keeps its bond.
